description: Tool to insert a string of text at a specified location within a Google Document. Use when you need to add new text content to an existing document. IMPORTANT: Two ways to specify insertion location: 1. Use 'insertion_index' to insert at a specific position (index 1 is safe for document start) 2. Use 'append_to_end=true' to append text to the end of the document (recommended for appending) CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: When using insertion_index, the index MUST fall within the bounds of an EXISTING paragraph. You cannot insert text at arbitrary indices or at structural boundaries (e.g., table starts). The index must also be strictly less than the document's end index. To safely append text without index concerns, use append_to_end=true.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: The ID of the document tab to insert text into. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.

segment_id.title: Segment Id
segment_id.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote to insert text into. Leave empty or omit to insert into the document body. Works with both append_to_end and insertion_index modes.
segment_id.human_parameter_description: Optionally specify a header, footer, or footnote ID. Leave empty for document body.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the document to insert text into.
document_id.human_parameter_description: Provide the unique identifier of the document where you want to insert the text.

append_to_end.title: Append To End
append_to_end.description: Set to true to append text to the end of the document body. When true, the 'insertion_index' parameter is ignored. This is the recommended way to add text at the end of a document as it avoids index boundary issues.
append_to_end.human_parameter_description: Set to true to add text at the end of the document. This is the safest way to append content.

text_to_insert.title: Text To Insert
text_to_insert.description: The string of text to insert. Alternatively, you can provide this as 'text'.
text_to_insert.human_parameter_description: Enter the text you wish to add to the document.

insertion_index.title: Insertion Index
insertion_index.description: The zero-based UTF-16 code unit index where text will be inserted. Alternatively, you can provide this as 'index'. CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: (1) The index MUST fall within the bounds of an EXISTING paragraph - you cannot insert at arbitrary indices or at structural boundaries like table starts. (2) The index MUST be strictly less than the document's end index. Index 1 is the minimum valid index and is safe for inserting at the document start. To determine valid indices, first retrieve the document structure using GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID to identify paragraph boundaries. For safely adding text without index concerns, set 'append_to_end' to true instead. Either 'insertion_index' or 'append_to_end' must be provided.
insertion_index.human_parameter_description: Provide the position in the document where you want your text to be inserted. The index MUST be within an existing paragraph's boundaries. Use index 1 to safely insert at the document start. Leave empty and set append_to_end=true to append to the end.

WriteControl.title: WriteControl

targetRevisionId.title: Target Revision Id
targetRevisionId.description: The target revision ID for the write request to be applied to. This is an optional advanced feature that supports collaborative editing. Allows writing against an older revision while merging changes with collaborator modifications. The server resolves conflicting changes, creating a new revision.

requiredRevisionId.title: Required Revision Id
requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the document that the write request will be applied to. If this is not the latest revision of the document, the request will not be processed and will return a 400 bad request error. When a document is opened and the latest version is retrieved, the revision ID can be used to target a specific version. Processing requires this to match the current document revision.

WriteControl.description: Provides control over how write requests are executed.
